ModelChoice.description: Which model to read: the current one, or the newest published.

oneOf.description:
The session's current revision's model, rebuilt if it isn't yet: what an agent that
just edited reads.

The newest model published, which may be an older revision's, read at once: what a
UI reads while a rebuild runs.

request.description:
`timeline`'s request: the document's features as the browser and the timeline draw them,
each with its health, from the model named.

session.description: The session's ID, as `open` gave it.

request.title: TimelineRequest

FeatureId.description: A feature's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u).

Health.description: A feature's health, as the model gave it: healthy (built, or solved, with no problem or warning), warning (built with warnings), error (not built, or built failing a check: a failure, a broken reference, drift; or blocked by a failure upstream), suppressed, or unknown (not built by this model: added or edited since, or using one that was; stopped by a kernel fault; or no model at all).

TimelineEntry.description: A feature as the browser and the timeline draw it.

id.description: Its ID. Unique, but in a document the gate refuses for an ID used twice.

inputs.description:
The features it names: its `base` and `tool`, then its `sketch`, then, for a sketch on
a face, the feature its `plane.face` begins with, in that order.

problems.description: How many problems the model has on it, whose text `check` gives.

type.description: Its type, as the document writes it (`sketch`, `pad`, `fillet`, ...).

warnings.description: How many warnings the model has on it, whose text `check` gives.

result.description:
`timeline`'s result. The features are the session's document's at its revision; their
health is the model's, of `model_revision`, which may be older.

bodies.description:
The bodies the model has, in timeline order: the solids no later feature consumes.
Empty with no model.

features.description:
The features, in timeline order: null if the text doesn't read as a document. While
the gate refuses the document, every health is `unknown`, and an ID used twice is
listed twice, so don't key entries by ID then.

model_revision.description:
The revision of the model the health comes from, as the response's `model` names
it: older than `revision` where the published model is an older revision's. Null
with no model to read (a document the gate refused, with nothing published).

problems.description:
How many problems the gate found in the document (or the reader, in text that
doesn't read as one): 0 for a document the gate took, whose model's problems
`check` gives.

revision.description: The session's revision, whose document the features are.

result.title: TimelineResult
